punakamma.p: [ puna + kamma ] (na) CL=10 Doing again-more-once again, Doing of the vinayakamma-happening of the law-suit again.

R:
punakamma：ပုန-ကမ္မ （န）
တစ်ဖန်ပြုခြင်း။
ပုနကမ္မာယ၊ တစ်ဖန်ကံဖြစ်စေခြင်းငှာ။

punakātabba.p: [ puna + kātabba ] (na) CL=10 That which is-should be done again-more-once again.
